description:
One question a night, and a record you can trust.

NoBuy asks one thing at the end of each day: did you buy anything unnecessary? Answer it in a tap. The run of kept days grows on a dial you can read at a glance, and everything you log stays on your device — no account, no bank connection, no tracking.

▸ ANSWER FROM ANYWHERE

The widget puts the question on your Home Screen with both answers on it — No and Yes — so a day can be recorded without opening the app. The Lock Screen carries the run and today's state. The whole widget family is free.

▸ WHEN THE URGE IS ACTUALLY HAPPENING

• Urge timer — ten minutes on a dial. Most urges do not survive it, and nothing is scored either way.
• Impulse checklist — five questions before you buy, and you can add, remove and reorder them so they are your questions.
• Waiting list — hold a thing for 24 hours. Most of them stop being interesting.

▸ A RECORD THAT DOES NOT ARGUE WITH YOU

Every day is one of five plain truths: kept, spent, essentials only, frozen, or not yet answered. Rent, bills, transport and groceries never break a run. A day answered wrongly can be edited or deleted — nothing you enter is permanent by accident.

▸ FREE, AND MEANT TO STAY USEFUL

The nightly question, the answer, the run and best counts, the calendar, the last 90 days of your record, one freeze a month, both interventions, three waiting slots, CSV export, and the entire widget family.

▸ NOBUY PRO

Every day on record, back to the first · the analysis layer: monthly trend, weekday pattern, streak history, category split, no-spend rate and savings estimate · an open waiting list · self-set challenges · unlimited essential categories · unlimited freezes · five dial finishes.

Monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial. Cancel any time in Settings before the trial ends and nothing is charged.

Already bought the one-time unlock? It stays yours, permanently. Nothing to re-buy, no trial, no expiry.

▸ PRIVACY

Your data stays on your device. No account. No analytics. No data collection of any kind. Your spending is nobody else's business, including ours.

▸ WHO IT IS FOR

No-buy and no-spend challenge keepers · low-buy year and underconsumption followers · anyone saving toward one specific thing · anyone who wants to stop buying things they will not remember in a month.

Questions or feedback? theknack2020@gmail.com

whatsNew:

• A widget family: answer the day from the Home Screen without opening NoBuy, and read the run from the Lock Screen. Free, all of it.
• The impulse checklist is now yours to shape — add your own questions, remove the ones that do not fit, reorder them.
• Pro is a subscription now, monthly or yearly with a 7-day free trial. If you already bought the one-time unlock, it stays yours permanently: nothing to re-buy, no trial, no expiry.
• The free tier got more generous: the last 90 days on every surface, both interventions in full, CSV export, and the entire widget family.
